description: Scopes and attaches the GLEIF Golden Copy hash-pin (BUNDLE-ENRICH-BUILD-SPEC.md §4) to an evidence bundle, narrowly, per bundle type. The bundle builder states bundle_asserts_lei_identity explicitly -- true (attach the enrichment), false (does not apply), or leaves it undeclared, which is reported as its own distinct state rather than guessed toward either. When applicable, the hash-pin logic itself is reused verbatim from art-599-gleif-snapshot-digest -- the same paste-in bytes, ISO 17442 LEI checksum, and CDF-XML LastUpdateDate extraction, never a second implementation. Every output carries the proof-vs-corroboration hierarchy (§0): this enrichment is CORROBORATION, never PROOF -- the bundle's own hash + RFC3161/OTS timestamp anchor is unaffected by whether it is present, absent, or inapplicable. No recurring duty: one pin per bundle-build invocation, no scheduler, no freshness promise.
